evidence.title: Barret Zoph, the Thinking Machines co-founder ousted before joining OpenAI, is now at Google

summary: Barret Zoph, who co‑founded the AI startup Thinking Machines and was recently ousted before completing a move to OpenAI, has now taken a position at Google. The hire underscores Google's continued focus on bolstering its AI talent pool amid intensifying industry competition.
title: Former Thinking Machines co‑founder Barret Zoph joins Google after brief stint at OpenAI
